opening.argument: The video promotes Forsage XGold through a claimed 1,200% profit from a $10 starting amount, while displaying projected returns as high as Rp.16.320.000 from Rp.2.900.000. It tells viewers to open slots, continue unlimited reinvestment, join the speaker's team, and recruit two members across four levels to obtain profit. The recruitment structure is explicit: “Each of you is only required to duplicate only 2 members at the bottom up to four levels You must duplicate 2 members And then roll up, till the 4 levels You will get the profit.” The speaker also offers three team slots and directs viewers to WhatsApp to build a network team, tying participation and recruitment to substantial promised returns.
